title: Weaver writer
description: Who writes waiting flags. Install and update default to Codex using its configured model. Set enabled to false to disable writing explicitly.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, for the editor.

runtime.description: The runtime that writes the cards.

model.description: The model the runtime writes with. Without it, the runtime chooses.

effort.description: How hard the model thinks, in the words of its runtime (`low`, `high`, ...). Without it, the runtime chooses.

timeoutSeconds.description: The time the writer is given. A flag it did not write up in time stays raw: it is listed and closed like a card.

skill.description: The file that tells the writer how this project wants its cards written, relative to the repository root. Its header lists the `sections` of the body of a card. Weaver guards the file. Without a skill, a card has the sections Observation, Context, Trace and Uncertainties.

batches.description: Five flags per batch; four batches per automatic start by default.
